strings.new_session_menu: More ways to start a session
strings.quick_launch_editor_not_initialized: Quick launch editor is not initialized.
strings.process_terminated: Process was terminated. Press any key to close.
strings.empty_description: Open a terminal on this computer or run one of your launches.
strings.modes_no_other_modes: No other modes yet. Kubernetes and agent work will appear here.
strings.containers_not_installed_title: Docker or Podman is not installed
strings.containers_not_installed_text: Containers mode shows the containers, images, volumes and networks of a Docker or Podman engine on this computer. Install one of them, then check again.
strings.containers_docker_stopped_title: Docker is installed but not running
strings.containers_docker_stopped_text: The docker command is here, but nothing answers on its socket. Start the Docker service, then check again.
strings.containers_docker_stopped_hint: On macOS, open Docker Desktop instead.
strings.containers_podman_off_title: Podman is installed but its API service is off
strings.containers_podman_off_text: OTTY talks to Podman through its API socket, which is off by default. Turn it on for your user, then check again.
strings.containers_podman_off_hint: On macOS, run podman machine start instead.
strings.containers_both_off_title: Docker and Podman are installed, but neither is answering
strings.containers_both_off_text: The docker and podman commands are here, but nothing answers on their sockets. Start the one you use, then check again.
strings.containers_both_off_docker_label: To start Docker, run this in a terminal
strings.containers_both_off_podman_label: To turn on the Podman API service, run this in a terminal
strings.containers_docker_no_access_title: OTTY has no access to the Docker socket
strings.tpl_containers_docker_no_access_text: {socket} belongs to the docker group, and your user is not in it.
strings.containers_docker_no_access_label: Add your user to the docker group
strings.containers_docker_no_access_hint: Log out and back in afterwards. Members of the docker group have root-level access to this computer.
strings.containers_podman_no_access_title: OTTY has no access to the Podman socket
strings.tpl_containers_podman_no_access_text: Your user may not connect to {socket}. Turn on your own Podman socket, which needs no extra rights, then check again.
strings.containers_podman_no_access_label: Turn on your own Podman socket
strings.containers_podman_no_access_hint: It shows your own containers, not root's. On macOS, run podman machine start instead.
strings.containers_docker_no_access_podman_off_t: OTTY has no access to Docker, and Podman is off
strings.tpl_containers_docker_no_access_podman_o: {socket} belongs to the docker group, and your user is not in it. Podman is installed, but its API service is off.
strings.containers_podman_no_access_docker_off_t: OTTY has no access to Podman, and Docker is not running
strings.tpl_containers_podman_no_access_docker_o: Your user may not connect to the Podman socket {socket}. Docker is installed, but it is not running.
strings.containers_panel_not_installed: No engine found on this computer.
strings.containers_panel_podman_off: The Podman API service is off.
strings.containers_panel_both_off: Docker and Podman are not answering.
strings.containers_panel_docker_no_access: No access to the Docker socket.
strings.containers_panel_podman_no_access: No access to the Podman socket.
strings.containers_panel_docker_no_access_podman: No access to Docker, and Podman is off.
strings.containers_panel_podman_no_access_docker: No access to Podman, and Docker is not running.
strings.tpl_containers_looked_for: OTTY looked for {places}, and for docker and podman on PATH and in the usual install folders.
strings.containers_looked_for_commands: OTTY looked for docker and podman on PATH and in the usual install folders.
strings.containers_image_dangling: Dangling: no tag and no container uses it
strings.containers_status_both_off: docker and podman are not answering
strings.tpl_containers_status_docker_no_access_p: permission denied on {socket}, podman socket is off
strings.tpl_containers_status_podman_no_access_d: permission denied on {socket}, docker is not running
strings.containers_shell_needs_docker: Shell needs the docker command. Install Docker, then check again.
strings.containers_shell_needs_podman: Shell needs the podman command. Install Podman, then check again.
strings.containers_remove_container_text: The container and the changes made inside it are deleted. Named volumes stay.
strings.tpl_containers_prune_containers_text: Stopped containers to delete: {count}. The changes made inside them are lost; named volumes stay.
strings.containers_remove_image_text: The image is deleted from this computer. You can pull it again later.
strings.containers_force_remove_image: Force: a container still uses it
strings.containers_remove_tag_text: Only this tag goes. The image stays, with its other tags.
strings.containers_force_untags_image_text: Only this tag goes. A container still uses the image, so the image stays, without a tag.
strings.containers_force_deletes_image_text: The image is deleted. The stopped containers that use it stay.
strings.containers_force_deletes_containers_text: The image is deleted, and so are the stopped containers that use it.
strings.containers_remove_image_needs_force_text: A container still uses this image, so the engine refuses unless Force is on.
strings.containers_remove_image_refused_text: A running container uses this image, so the engine refuses. Stop it first.
strings.tpl_containers_prune_images_text: Dangling images to delete: {count}. They have no tag and no container uses them.
strings.containers_remove_volume_text: The volume and all data in it are deleted. This cannot be undone.
strings.tpl_containers_prune_volumes_text: Volumes no container uses: {count}. They and all data in them are deleted, named ones too. This cannot be undone.
strings.tpl_containers_prune_anonymous_volumes_t: Anonymous volumes no container uses: {count}. They and all data in them are deleted. Named volumes stay. This cannot be undone.
strings.containers_remove_network_text: Containers can no longer join it.
strings.tpl_containers_prune_networks_text: Networks no container uses: {count}. Built-in networks stay.
strings.tpl_containers_volume_in_use_hint: Remove the container {names} first; the engine keeps volumes that are in use.
strings.containers_built_in_network_hint: The engine creates this network itself; it cannot be removed.
strings.containers_network_in_use_hint: Stop or remove the connected containers first.
strings.containers_logs_hint: Last 500 lines, new lines appear as they come.
strings.containers_run_subtitle: Starts a new container in the background. If it needs a terminal, open it with Shell afterwards.
strings.containers_run_pull_missing: Pull the image if it is missing
strings.containers_run_command_hint: Leave empty to run the image's own command.
strings.tpl_containers_run_command_hint: Leave empty to run the image's own command: {command}
strings.containers_run_volume_source: Volume or folder on this computer
strings.containers_run_relabel: Let the container read this folder (:z)
strings.containers_run_relabel_hint: Changes the SELinux labels of the folder's files.
strings.containers_restart_hint_on_failure: Starts again when it exits with an error.
strings.containers_restart_hint_unless_stopped: Comes back after a crash or a reboot, until you stop it.
strings.containers_restart_hint_always: Comes back after a crash or a reboot, even after you stopped it.
strings.containers_restart_hint_auto_remove: A container that is removed when it stops cannot restart.
strings.containers_run_auto_remove: Remove the container when it stops
strings.containers_run_err_image: Type an image, for example nginx:1.27.
strings.containers_run_err_port: A port is a number from 1 to 65535.
strings.containers_run_err_container_path: The path in the container must start with /, for example /cache.
strings.containers_run_err_source_required: Type a volume name or a folder on this computer.
strings.containers_run_err_source_missing: This folder is not on this computer.
strings.containers_run_err_source_not_answering: This folder is not answering. A network drive may be unavailable.
strings.containers_run_err_source_home_unknown: Your home folder is not known, so ~ cannot be used. Type the full path.
strings.containers_run_fix_fields: Fix the marked fields to run.
strings.containers_run_panel_hint: What the image sets on its own. The form overrides it.
strings.containers_run_image_pulled_first: Not on this computer yet; it is pulled first.
strings.containers_run_image_not_pulled: Not on this computer yet. Turn on the pull switch, or the run fails.
strings.containers_run_no_image: Type an image to see what it sets on its own.
strings.palette_toggle_left_panel: Show or hide the left panel
strings.wizard_subtitle: Saved launches open a new session with one click.
strings.exit_behavior_hint: If it fails, the session stays open so you can read the error.
strings.secret_prompt_password_rejected: The server rejected the password. Try again.
strings.desc_equalize_panes: Give every pane the same size after a split
strings.desc_theme: The window and the terminal switch together
strings.desc_shell: Program started in every new terminal
strings.desc_default_editor: Opens files from the Files panel
strings.err_title_duplicate: A sibling with this title already exists.
strings.err_ssh_port_positive: SSH port must be greater than 0.
strings.tpl_working_directory_not_directory: Working directory is not a directory: {path}
strings.tpl_identity_file_not_file: Identity file is not a file: {path}
strings.tpl_secret_prompt_passphrase_hint: {launch} needs this key to connect as {account}.
strings.tpl_secret_prompt_password_hint: {launch} needs the password to connect as {account}.
strings.tpl_process_exited: Process exited with code {code}. Press any key to close.
strings.tpl_pinned_modes_save_failed: Could not save the pinned modes: {error}
strings.tpl_settings_file_invalid: The settings file is broken, so the defaults are used: {error}
